moderateMinutes.name: Moderate training minutes
moderateMinutes.description: Heart-rate-estimated time during logged workouts at 50% to below 70% of your specified maximum heart rate. Vigorous minutes are excluded. Missing heart-rate data is not treated as moderate activity.

weightedTrainingMinutes.weeklyExplanation: WHO recommends adults accumulate 150–300 minutes of moderate aerobic activity or 75–150 minutes of vigorous aerobic activity per week, or an equivalent combination. One vigorous minute equals two moderate minutes: weighted training minutes = moderate + 2 × vigorous minutes. For example, 100 moderate + 25 vigorous = 150 weighted minutes. More than 300 may provide additional health benefits. Muscle-strengthening activity is also recommended at least two days a week. The app estimates intensity from heart-rate data; these heart-rate zones are not WHO’s definition of intensity.
weightedTrainingMinutes.name: Weighted training minutes
weightedTrainingMinutes.description: Moderate minutes + 2 × vigorous minutes per day, from workouts where both can be calculated. Light activity and time without heart-rate data are excluded. The weighting follows WHO’s equivalence for adults’ recommended 150–300 moderate or 75–150 vigorous aerobic minutes per week. Heart-rate zones are an estimate, not WHO’s definition of intensity. Strength training has a separate recommendation.

calories.name: Logged calories
calories.description: Total calories from food and drinks logged each day. Days without logged entries have no value. A partially logged day does not represent your total energy intake. The average line shows the mean of daily values in the selected period.

glycemic_index.noCarbohydrates: No logged carbohydrates to calculate coverage
glycemic_index.coverageExplanation: Missing GI is not zero. Carbohydrate-free food needs no GI. The average describes only entries with known GI.
glycemic_index.name: GI (glycemic index)
glycemic_index.description: Calculated automatically from the food log. Each point is the carbohydrate-weighted daily GI for entries with known GI. The average line shows the unweighted mean of these daily values in the selected period. Days without data are excluded. Catalog reference values and AI estimates may contribute; this estimates the food you logged.

recovery_status.name: Recovery status
recovery_status.description: Recovery score calculated during sync from resting heart rate, sleep and HRV compared with your personal baseline.

ldl.name: LDL cholesterol
ldl.description: The "bad" cholesterol strongly linked to cardiovascular risk.

apob.name: ApoB (Apolipoprotein B)
apob.description: Shows the number of harmful cholesterol particles in the blood.

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.description: Blood fats influenced by diet, alcohol, and insulin resistance.

hdl.name: HDL cholesterol
hdl.description: The "good" cholesterol that helps remove fat from the bloodstream.

systolic_bp.name: Systolic blood pressure
systolic_bp.description: The top blood pressure value when the heart contracts.

diastolic_bp.name: Diastolic blood pressure
diastolic_bp.description: The bottom blood pressure value when the heart relaxes between beats.

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting blood glucose
fasting_glucose.description: Blood sugar level after at least 8 hours of fasting.

hba1c.name: HbA1c (long-term blood sugar)
hba1c.description: Shows average blood sugar over the past 2–3 months.

fasting_insulin.name: Fasting insulin
fasting_insulin.description: Hormone that regulates blood sugar and reveals insulin resistance early.

vitd_25oh.name: Vitamin D status
vitd_25oh.description: Stored form of vitamin D measured in the blood.

calcium.name: Calcium
calcium.description: Essential mineral for bones, muscles, and nerve function.

pth.name: Parathyroid hormone (PTH)
pth.description: Hormone that regulates calcium balance and vitamin D metabolism.

tsh.name: TSH (thyroid stimulating hormone)
tsh.description: Shows how the thyroid is regulated by the pituitary gland.

free_t4.name: Free T4
free_t4.description: One of the main thyroid hormones controlling metabolism.

resting_hr.name: Resting heart rate
resting_hr.description: Heart rate at rest — an indicator of fitness and recovery.

vo2_max.name: VO₂ max
vo2_max.description: Maximal oxygen uptake — an estimate of your body's aerobic capacity and oxygen utilization during exercise.

trendChart.noLifeStyleEntries: No lifestyle entries logged for this day.

trendChart.subtitle: Last {{count}} registrations
trendChart.empty: Register {{metric}} on at least two days to see the trend over time.

sleep_duration.name: Sleep duration
sleep_duration.description: Total time you sleep each night.

sleepStages.title: Sleep stages
sleepStages.explainer: Deep sleep is crucial for physical recovery and immune function. REM sleep supports memory consolidation and emotional regulation.

deep_sleep.name: Deep sleep
deep_sleep.description: The deepest sleep phase supporting physical recovery and repair.

rem_sleep.name: REM sleep
rem_sleep.description: The sleep phase supporting memory, learning, and emotional processing.

sleep_wake.name: Wake time
sleep_wake.description: The time you wake up in the morning.

sleep_latency.name: Sleep onset time
sleep_latency.description: How long it takes you to fall asleep.

intense_exercise_before_sleep.name: Intense exercise before sleep
intense_exercise_before_sleep.description: Record if you performed intense exercise before going to bed.

waist.name: Waist circumference
waist.description: Measurement around the abdomen — a strong marker of metabolic health.

bss.name: Stool type (Bristol scale)
bss.description: Scale describing bowel movement consistency and gut health.

energy.name: Energy level
energy.description: How energetic and alert you feel.

activeMinutes.name: Active minutes
activeMinutes.description: Total time from imported and manually logged workouts per day, at any intensity. Overlapping imported workouts are counted only once.

intensityMinutes.name: Intensity minutes
intensityMinutes.description: Heart-rate-based time during logged workouts at or above 70% of your specified maximum heart rate. Workouts without sufficient heart-rate data have no value. Overlapping intervals are counted only once.

todaysSteps.name: Today's steps
todaysSteps.description: Total number of steps taken today.

recoveryStatus.changeInfo: Resting heart rate, sleep duration and HRV affect recovery status. Editing or deleting a value recalculates and saves that day’s status. The following 28 days may also change because the value contributes to your baseline. Scores are removed when data is insufficient.
